title: Ammu mujhe bachalo
body:
shabbir ki yateema ro ro ke keh rahi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
<<DIVIDER>>
har baat par tamacha ye kaisi zindagi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
<<DIVIDER>>
tera chacha sitam se tujhko agar bachale
zaalim ye keh raha hai awaaz de bula le
tum ko pukarne ki zaalim ne choot di hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir shimr aa raha hai ab le ke taziyana
tewar se lag raha hai phir se hoo mai nishana
bebas mai ho gayi hoo kaisi ye bebasi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise bhala mai ammu ab ye sitam sahungi
raahon mein kis tarha se panjo ke bal chalungi
chote hai paaon mere takleef ye badi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
gustaakh kar raha hai mujhse ye bad tameezi
uska mutaaliba hai mere liye kaneezi
chalni jo rooh bhi ye sun kar laraz gayi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
le lega jaan meri zindan ka ye andhera
kehti hai ye sakina dam ghut raha hai mera
chaaron taraf hai pehra kaisi ye bekasi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhi nahi hai maine aisi koi musibat
ab tak laraz rahi hai choti si ek turbat
jaise koi bhatiji ab tak ye bolti hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
rukhsar neelgu hai kaano se khoon hai jaari
daaman jala hua hai mujh par ghashi hai taari
ab har ghadi hi mujh par aafat ki ek ghadi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab jao karbala to yasir ye kaam karna
sajid mere chacha ko mera payam dena
kehna teri bhatiji ab tak ye keh rahi hai
ammu mujhe bacha lo
shabbir ki yateema...
author: Yasir Abbas
